_doc: Rules and reasoned allow-lists for scan-dist.mjs (ADR-0012 scan scope S1-S7, patterns section 11; S9 practice_flow from lead review 2 R0-L12). Every allow entry needs a reason. Read by scan-dist.mjs, app/__tests__/guardrails.test.tsx and app/practice/warmup.test.tsx.

text of Radix accessibility warnings; never fetched
Tailwind licence banner comment in the CSS
react-router URL-parsing base for new URL(); never fetched

disclosure_only.why: G-2 disclosure sentences say chips have NO cash value and can't be bought (patterns section 11 contextual rule)

html_sentences.text: Chips are play money with no cash value and can't be bought, sold or exchanged. This is not gambling. For adults 18+.

practice_flow._doc: S9: once the shell warm-up has run after the gate (any gated screen, or X-01 for a tab that passed the gate before), Practice -> Deal me in -> Leave, again and again, must fetch nothing. Every chunk reached lazily (import() or a Worker script) from app.html is listed here: preloaded by that warm-up (practice/warmup.ts PracticeWarmup, once per tab; warmup.test.tsx and GateRoute.test.tsx assert one trigger per entry) or outside the practice flow, with the reason. Names are Vite chunk names ([name]-[hash].js).

preloaded.how: the /practice route chunk (React.lazy(loadPracticeScreen)): the shell warm-up preloads it with the same loader, PR-01 is that chunk; TableScreen, the menu sheet, BetSizer, result, refill and alert screens are static parts of it
shell warm-up after the gate: composition.loadGameServices() (cached for the page)
shell warm-up after the gate: prewarmPracticeHost() spawns the tab's dealer Worker, reused by every table (R0-L12)
shell warm-up after the gate: prewarmMetrics() spawns the tab's metrics Worker, reused by every table (R0-L12)

outside.why: default build's empty ko dictionary (vite.config koSwitch): imported only when FEATURE_KO is on, which this build is not
FEATURE_KO builds: I18nProvider loads the ko dictionary at app start, before any practice screen

computed_imports.why: react-router's framework-mode loadRouteModule (import(route.module) of a HydratedRouter manifest). routes.tsx is a createBrowserRouter data router with no route `lazy` and no route modules, so this never runs
